rules.style: Career Empire World futuristic 2.5D school/career city with navy shadows, cyan/teal hologram lighting, green campus landscaping, restrained gold accents, and readable game silhouettes.

assets.name: Base Grass Tile
assets.reviewNotes: 2026-08-27: Approved after resizing Grokbot v2 source from 1254x1254 to the required 256x256. Quiet base grass, no flowers/large clover clusters, acceptable 4x4 repeat preview.
assets.promptSpecific: Base repeatable grass tile for the campus. Lush but not busy, with subtle texture variation and enough open space for buildings and characters.

assets.name: Grass Flowers Tile
assets.reviewNotes: 2026-08-27: Approved. Exact 256x256, seamless edge metrics, decorative flower grass variant suited for park/detail areas.
assets.promptSpecific: Repeatable grass tile with small campus flowers and subtle colour variation. It must tile cleanly and stay readable under props.

assets.name: Worn Grass Tile
assets.reviewNotes: 2026-08-27: Approved. Exact 256x256, seamless edge metrics, reads clearly as worn grass for unimproved areas.
assets.promptSpecific: Repeatable worn grass tile for areas before improvement. Duller, patchier, but still matching the campus world style.

assets.name: Garden Edge
assets.reviewNotes: 2026-08-27: Approved. Exact 256x256 transparent PNG, strong garden edge/flower bed overlay for landscaping.
assets.promptSpecific: Transparent 2.5D grass-to-landscaping edge piece that can sit over ground tiles.

assets.name: Plaza Stone Base Tile
assets.reviewNotes: 2026-08-27: Approved. Exact 256x256, seamless edge metrics, quiet plaza stone base tile.
assets.promptSpecific: Main repeatable stone plaza tile. Futuristic but not too bright; must work as the dominant walkable town-square surface.

assets.name: Plaza Stone Glow Tile
assets.reviewNotes: 2026-08-27: Approved. Exact 256x256, seamless edge metrics, cyan glow pattern matches world direction.
assets.promptSpecific: Repeatable plaza tile with subtle cyan circuit glow lines. Seamless and restrained.

assets.name: Road Straight
assets.reviewNotes: 2026-08-27: Approved. Exact 256x256 transparent PNG, readable road segment with landscaping edges.

assets.reviewNotes: 2026-08-27: Approved. Exact 256x256 transparent PNG, corner road piece looks consistent with straight segment.
